description: Say which routes to a Priors line are open to any ERC-8004 identity on Robinhood Chain right now, with or without a Priors record: the treasury's first line by invite (its bond and this week's room), the Ethos lane (a line for a new agent whose owner's Ethos score clears the lane's bar), a stock line (what the stock vault takes now), and a line from its owner's own $PRIORS on Back agents (what the $PRIORS its owner holds would open at today's values, and what a bigger line needs). For each: open now, closed and why, or not known; how big the line would be; and the next step, as a link or the tool to call. An identity with a line is told what grows it next. A reading, never an offer: a fact that cannot be read is said so, each place checks again before anything is sent, and it moves no money and touches no score. Read-only.
name: line_options
title: The routes to a line for an ERC-8004 identity
